description: Language-neutral cases for the history-editing band and window indicator (ticket 26/09/30 NON-DESTRUCTIVE-HISTORY-EDITING, design §10, §22): every stage of HistoryPatch.timeTravel, the lines a shell shows in English and German, the controls in order — each with the id both shells give it (`controlId`), the reserved verb it dispatches (args carry the session generation unless the row states its own `args`) and the refusal label that disables it — the default remappable chords (never Escape) and the indicator's accessible name. `labels` is the ONE copy of every text the band, the indicator, the peer notes and the refusal notices show: per label key (React's i18n key) the `normal` and the `beginner` tier in English and German, placeholders in single braces (`{target}`, `{done}`, `{total}`, `{level}`, `{count}`, `{name}`); the React catalogue is pinned to it by test, the wgpu shell embeds this file and resolves `label(key, tier, locale)`, and every `text` of this corpus (and of `🧫️time-travel-peers`) is a label of the table at the normal tier. `refusals` name the label key of each code. `transitions` are what one change of the focused program's session asks of either shell: reveal the History panel on the edge into a new session, move keyboard focus to the draft editor's first input, the band or the finalize prompt, and — when a replay completes blocked — reveal the panel again and scroll to the first blocking row (`scrollTo`, a node key of the guest's history body).

transitions.name: beginning a session reveals the History panel and focuses the draft's first input
accepting a draft moves focus to the band while the replay runs
a replay progress step moves nothing
the review after a replay keeps focus on the band
Next problem from the review focuses the failing mutation's first input
switching the draft to another mutation focuses its first input
editing the same draft moves nothing
going back from the prompt returns focus to the band
a new session after another one reveals the panel again
a session already open when the shell first sees it reveals the panel and focuses its band
a replay that completes blocked reveals the History panel again and scrolls to the first blocking row
a review that stays blocked moves nothing, whatever its next problem
discarding a draft back into a blocked review reveals and scrolls to the first blocking row
